content: {"phoneNote":"Hero holds together well, but the radiator illustration only peeks above the bar and the footer repeats the business name twice at two sizes right under a contact block that repeats the hero phone number.","desktopNote":"Strong split hero with the illustration carrying the right half; the dark contact section leaves a dead band under “Navodila za pot” and the segmented pipe divider above it reads like a broken tile pattern.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Swap the radiator for a chimney/roof illustration (or a real photo of the sweep at work) and on phone shrink it so it sits beside or just under the headline inside the first screen.","Merge the dark contact block and footer: drop the oversized second ‘Dimnikarstvo Vidmar’, show the number once large, and remove the empty band under the directions link.","Make the second pipe divider continuous like the first, and give the fifth service on desktop a full-width row or pair it with a photo so the grid has no empty cell."],"blockers":[]}
